name: Hacker News stories with >50 points: headlines per day
source: Hacker News via the Algolia HN Search API
notes: Number of de-duplicated headlines per day. Hacker News (news.ycombinator.com) story titles from the Algolia HN Search API, one query per New York calendar day (DST-aware midnight to midnight), 2007-02-19 onward. Tech-industry news and links, not general news. 'points' is the story's final score, so membership of the >50-point set uses votes cast after day D (stories collect most votes within ~24 h): known_after_days 2 so every story has had >= 40 h of voting by the US close it is first used at. Moderators sometimes edit titles later; Algolia holds the current title. Volume grows with the site (2007-2010) then is roughly flat. 'default' is excluded from the crisis words (on HN it is nearly always technical, e.g. 'enabled by default'); 'crash' is often a software crash. transform level: the test subtracts a trailing 252-trading-day mean before standardizing, which absorbs slow drift in archive volume; `anomaly` would compare with the same date in earlier years and drift on a growing archive.
